headline: Purchases of trucks, a compressor, an excavator, and other equipment, plus two parking garage leases with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
summary: Twelve purchase requests from the Purchasing Manager will be considered, each with a spending limit. Three items tabled at the November 4, 2026 meeting also return: a sewer and drain flow monitoring system and two garage leases.
items: Training Grounds Prop, not to exceed $581,997
Air Supply Unit, not to exceed $1,360,789.65
2026 Kenworth T280 service truck, not to exceed $261,373
Two 2027 Freightliner cab and chassis with plow, not to exceed $660,616.00
2027 Ford F-350 4-wheel-drive pickup truck, not to exceed $102,376.00
John Deere excavator, not to exceed $400,000
Load Master Read Load waste collection vehicles, not to exceed $1,099,888.11
Ford F-250 pickup truck with plow, not to exceed $137,010.00
Whittke front loader waste collection vehicle, not to exceed $624,963.80
2027 Ford F-250 4-wheel-drive pickup truck, not to exceed $70,481.00
Ford F-250 4-wheel-drive pickup trucks, not to exceed $131,950
Sewer and drain flow monitoring system, not to exceed $25,000 (tabled at 11/4/26 meeting)
Resolution R-26-078, first amendment to High Street Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC (tabled at 11/4/26 meeting)
Resolution R-26-079, School Street Parking Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC (tabled at 11/4/26 meeting)
